Class BookDaoImpl

java.lang.Object
com.booklibrary.dao.impl.BookDaoImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
BookDao
public class BookDaoImpl extends Object implements BookDao
JDBC implementation of BookDao, backed by the book table in MySQL, joined with writer, genre and bookshelf. Author: Farid Rahmani Contribution: Implemented the JDBC persistence logic (SQL queries, PreparedStatements, result mapping) for this entity. Purpose: translates Book objects to and from rows in the book table, always returning the related writer, genre and bookshelf already populated so the UI never needs extra queries.

    • search

      public List<Book> search(String titleContains, Integer writerId, Integer genreId, Integer bookshelfId, String readingStatus) throws SQLException
      Builds the base SELECT dynamically, appending an AND condition for each non-null/non-blank filter, then runs it and maps every row to a fully populated Book.
      Specified by:
      search in interface BookDao
      Parameters:
      titleContains - text that must appear in the title or in the writer's name (case-insensitive), or null
      writerId - restrict to this writer's id, or null for any writer
      genreId - restrict to this genre's id, or null for any genre
      bookshelfId - restrict to this bookshelf's id, or null for any bookshelf
      readingStatus - restrict to this reading status, or null for any status
      Returns:
      the list of books matching the given filters
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the query fails
